run_multi_gpu_job: run a single or multi GPU job locally using multi_proc_run with a callable function
check_main_process: check if the current process is the main process using is_main_proc with local flag
reduce_tensors_across_gpus: perform scaled all_reduce on tensors across GPUs using scaled_all_reduce for distributed training
setup_distributed_backend: initialize torch.distributed and set the CUDA device using setup_distributed with config state
submit_job_with_submitit: submit a distributed training job using SubmititRunner with submitit for SLURM or local execution
